messages.subject: Meridian Quarter - title and contract pack
messages.plaintextBody:
James,

We act for Tarncliffe Asset Holdings on the sale of Meridian Quarter. Please find access to the data room. Title number is WYK482176, registered with title absolute. The draft contract incorporates the SCPC (3rd edn) and is on a TOGC basis. Our client's Northbank charge will be discharged on completion.

We look forward to your enquiries.

Marcus Pendle
Pendle Voss LLP

messages.plaintextBody:
Marcus,

Thank you. We've raised CPSE.1 and supplemental enquiries through the data room. Two priorities: (1) the status of the Unit 3 (Penrose & Vale) rent review due September 2026, and (2) the service charge arrears position on Units 4 and 5. We'll also need the executed DS1 or an undertaking for the Northbank charge before we can certify to the bank.

James

--
Whitfield Carter LLP | 22 Bishopsgate, London EC2N 4BQ
